verdict.rationale: Thoropass's official MCP server lets an AI assistant act in the workspace "within limits you set." The docs also say users can add or remove items "depending on what you want your agent to be able to do," which suggests configurable, scoped agent permissions. The evidence never shows a mechanism for issuing dedicated API credentials or tokens, and the snippets don't say what the removable items are. missing for 10: documented issuance of agent-specific API keys/tokens, an explicit list of permission scopes, read-only vs write scoping detail, credential revocation/rotation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: MCP lets the assistant work directly inside your Thoropass workspace, within limits you set.
Add or remove the last three depending on what you want your agent to be able to do.
